tasks.technical_notes: Edit existing SKILL.md (already modified by TASK-003 for feedback injection). Add a new major section for 'Continuous Incremental Review'. Key design: 1) After implementer completes a task and SubagentStop fires, team-lead checks if reviewer slots available (max 2 concurrent), 2) If slot available, spawn reviewer Task() for completed task, 3) On REJECTED signal, re-queue task with 'previous_rejections' context (leveraging TASK-003's feedback injection), 4) Continue dispatching pending implementer tasks in parallel with reviewers, 5) After all tasks processed, run final quality gate.
